transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dr. Okonkwo. What's going on with Liam today?

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: He's been pulling at his right ear for two days, and last night he had a fever of 101.8. He's had a runny nose all week.

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: Drinking fine, not eating much. He's still making wet diapers, well, pull-ups, about the usual.

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: He's allergic to penicillin, I think.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Do you know what happened when he had it?

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: Let me check my phone. No, sorry, that was his sister. Liam has no allergies. He had amoxicillin last winter and was fine.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Thanks for checking. What have you given him for the fever?

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: Children's acetaminophen last night, and it helped.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I know, buddy. Let me take a look. His temperature here is 100.9 and he weighs 17 kilograms. The right eardrum is red and bulging. The left eardrum looks normal. His throat is mildly red, the lungs are clear, and his neck is supple.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: He has a right middle ear infection, acute otitis media. I'm prescribing amoxicillin, 765 mg twice a day for 10 days. That's based on his weight.

transcript.speaker: companion
transcript.text: Okay. Can he go to daycare?

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Once he's been fever-free for 24 hours. Keep giving acetaminophen for fever or pain as the package says for his weight. If he's not better in 48 to 72 hours, or he gets a stiff neck or seems very sleepy, call our nurse line at 555-0187.

sections.title: Interval history
sections.text: 4-year-old boy, history from his mother. Pulling at the right ear for two days; fever of 101.8 last night; runny nose all week. Drinking fine, not eating much, usual wet pull-ups. Children's acetaminophen last night helped. No allergies; had amoxicillin last winter without problems.

sections.title: Physical exam
sections.text: Temperature 100.9. Weight 17 kg. Right eardrum red and bulging. Left eardrum normal. Throat mildly red. Lungs clear. Neck supple.

sections.title: Assessment and plan
sections.text: Acute otitis media, right ear. Amoxicillin 765 mg twice a day for 10 days, based on weight (17 kg). Acetaminophen for fever or pain as the package says for his weight. Back to daycare once fever-free for 24 hours. Call the nurse line if not better in 48 to 72 hours, or with a stiff neck or if very sleepy.

sections.title: Patient instructions
sections.text: Give amoxicillin 765 mg twice a day for 10 days. Give acetaminophen for fever or pain as the package says for his weight. Liam can go back to daycare once he has been fever-free for 24 hours. If he is not better in 48 to 72 hours, or he gets a stiff neck or seems very sleepy, call our nurse line at 555-0187.

mustNotInvent.description: Vomiting and diarrhea were not reported.

conflicts.description: His mother first says he is allergic to penicillin, then corrects it: that was his sister, and Liam has no allergies.
